raw.en: 56. Which of the following is necessary to obtain nuclear energy ? (A) Helium (B) Uranium (C) Aluminium (D) Chromium | 57. Which of the following is the male gamete ? (A) Ovum (B) Sperm (C) Ovary (D) Fallopian tube | 58. An example of parasitic plant is (A) Mushroom (B) Bryophyllum (C) Cuscuta (D) Pinus

notes: Q56 Physics, Q57-58 Biology. Answer key: Q56=(B) Uranium, Q57=(B) Sperm (pen mark on (B) matches printed-correct), Q58=(C) Cuscuta (Amarbel).
